{{Quote|You stand as if you're still wearing that skirt.''"<br />"Kama. ''Belt-spat. It's based on a traditional Mandalorian hunting ''kama''. It was designed to protect your legs. But it's just for show now.''"<br />"''Ah. It's certainly very showy.|[[Laseema]] and [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|ARC]] [[Clone Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Ordo Skirata|Ordo]]|<ref name="TZ">''[[Republic Commando: Triple Zero]]''</ref>}}
A '''''kama''''' was a flexible [[Leather/Legends|leather]] [[Armor/Legends|armor]] accoutrement worn from the [[Utility belt/Legends|belt]]. Inspired by the belt-spats of the [[Thyrsus/Legends|Thyrsus]] [[Sun Guard]], but adapted for wear by [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Soldier/Legends|warriors]], the ''kama'' became a traditional garment and recognized symbol of Mandalorian culture. Though the [[Homeworld/Legends|indigenous]] [[Rotas V indigenous fighters|fighters]] of [[Rotas V]] would also take up the use of ''kamas'' as '''command skirts''', it was the adaptation of the Mandalorian ''kama'' by the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone soldiers]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army]] that drew the traditional half-kilt widespread [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] attention.

Sturdy and resilient, ''kamas'' protected the legs of the wearer from low-flying shrapnel and debris kicked up by the chaos of battle, and were known for their ability to shield the wearer from the down-draft of a [[Jetpack/Legends|jetpack's]] rockets. Coming in a variety of [[Color/Legends|colors]], over [[Time/Legends|time]], many ''kama'' wearers chose to don the distinctive armored accessory as much for ceremonial value as protection.

==Description==
{{Quote|Nice skirt. Really suits you. Hand washable?"<br />"It's a kama.|[[Clone commando/Legends|Clone commando]] [[Fi Skirata|Fi]] and ARC Captain Ordo|<ref name="Omega Squad: Targets">{{InsiderCite|81|Omega Squad: Targets}}</ref>}}
A ''kama'' was a kilt-like<ref name="TC" /> piece of flexible, anti-blast [[Armor/Legends|armor]] worn from the waist. They were fastened to the wearer's [[Utility belt/Legends|belt]]<ref name="GttGAR" /> with a number of snaps.<ref name="TZ" /> Highly distinctive,<ref name="Odds">{{InsiderCite|87|Odds}}</ref> and typically made of sturdy [[Leather/Legends|leather]], ''kamas'' were valued for the protection they offered a wearer's [[Limb/Legends|legs]] from low-flying debris, shrapnel, and against rocket down-wash when worn in conjunction with a [[Jetpack/Legends|jetpack]].<ref name="GttGAR" /> While donning a ''kama'', [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] beings tended to stand up noticeably straighter, and the weight of a ''kama'' on the wearer's [[Skeleton/Legends|hips]] added a telltale swagger to their gait.<ref name="TZ" /> ''Kamas'' came in a variety of [[Color/Legends|colors]], including grey,<ref name="TC" /> yellow,<ref name="RotSVD" /> and blue,<ref name="Revelation" /> and were sometimes customized with personalized markings<ref name="Fives" /> or colored trim along the garment's edges.<ref name="TC" />

==History==
{{Quote|We're going to have a little ARC-to-ARC chat. About ''kama'' fashions or some such ''osik''.|[[Null-class Advanced Recon Commando|''Null''-class ARC trooper]] [[A'den Skirata|A'den]]|<ref name="TC" />}}
Among the earliest examples of belt-worn leg armor of the likes of the ''kama'' were those worn by the heatbeamer infantry of the [[Army/Legends|army]] of [[Xim/Legends|Xim the Despot]], used to protect their legs from the superheated exhausts of their [[Heatbeam|namesake weapons]].<ref name="TEGW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> Later, the [[Sun Guard]] of [[Thyrsus/Legends|Thyrsus]] wore similar protective belt-spats as part of their armor, which in turn inspired the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] people<ref name="GttGAR" />—with whom they clashed numerous times throughout history<ref name="GaW">''[[Galaxy at War]]''</ref>—to adapt the ''kama'' for themselves.<ref name="GttGAR" /> The ''kama'' evolved into a traditional element of the Mandalorian culture, worn by [[Hunting/Legends|hunters]]<ref name="TZ" /> and [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] alike, and it grew to be associated strongly with the Mandalorian people by the varied citizens of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="GttGAR" /> ''Kamas'' saw significant use by specialized units of Mandalorian soldiers under the reign of [[Mandalore the Uniter]],<ref name="TBHC">''[[The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett]]''</ref> and over [[Time/Legends|time]], the indigenous pro-[[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Rotas V indigenous fighters|fighters]] of [[Rotas V]] also took up the custom of wearing ''kamas''.<ref name="GttGAR" /> Even after the pacifistic [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorian]] faction broke from the warrior clans in the aftermath of the [[Mandalorian Excision]] of [[738 BBY]],<ref name="TEGW" /> and relinquished traditional [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian armor]] as part of their proscription of violence,<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> several members of the peaceful sect continued to wear ''kamas'' as part of their wardrobe.<ref name="Corruption">{{TCW|Corruption (episode)}}</ref> Following the rise of the radical and violent Mandalorian splinter group known as [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]],<ref name="TEGW" /> several of its members that specialized in jetpack operations adopted the use of ''kamas'' for protection.<ref name="TBHC" />

[[File:ARC_team.png|thumb|left|280px|The [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|ARC troopers]] were the first of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army's]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone soldiers]] to don ''kamas''.]]
As the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] came into existence on the [[Water/Legends|watery]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]], with it's [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone soldiers]] [[Clone template/Legends|cast]] from the [[DNA/Legends|genetic material]] of [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|''Mand'alor'']] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]],<ref name="O66">''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]''</ref> and instructed by the predominately Mandalorian training [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeants]] of the ''[[Cuy'val Dar]]'', the army took on several Mandalorian influences. One such element that was passed on to the clones from their instructors was the ''kamas''. The Grand Army's [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|Advanced Recon Commandos]] were the first to don ''kamas'' with [[ARC trooper armor/Legends|their armor]],<ref name="GttGAR" /> and both the [[Alpha-class Advanced Recon Commando|''Alpha''-class]] and [[Null-class Advanced Recon Commando|''Null''-class]] ARC [[Troop/Legends|troopers]] wore dark grey ''kamas'' edged in the color that coordinated with their [[Military rank/Legends|military rank]].<ref name="TC" /> Their early and iconic use of the ''kama''<ref name="GttGAR" /> led to the development of a saying among the ARC trooper's [[Commando/Legends|commando]] peers and friendly rivals, that "ARCs are all mouths and ''kamas''."<ref name="TZ" /><ref name="O66" />

Shortly after the outbreak of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="FFCody">{{FactFile2013|2|COD 1-4|Commander Cody}}</ref> when the Grand Army was deployed to fight for the Republic against the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|droid army]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], the ARC trooper [[Alpha (Advanced Recon Commando)|Alpha]] was called upon to begin a [[ARC program/Legends|training program]] wherein standard army clone [[Officer/Legends|officers]] would be trained with ARC skills, and encouraged to develop their battlefield independence. Upon graduating from the program, many of these new ARC-trained officers elected to wear [[Pauldron/Legends|pauldrons]] and ''kamas'' just as their ARC trooper instructors did. These officers, in turn, authorized their assistants and proven subordinates to customize their own [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|armor]] with the addition of accoutrements such as ''kamas'' and other specialized accessories.<ref name="GttGAR" /> ARC trooper officers including [[Echo/Legends|Echo]], [[Fives/Legends|Fives]],<ref name="Fives" /> [[Blitz/Legends|Blitz]], and [[Havoc (ARC trooper)/Legends|Havoc]] donned ''kamas'' with personalized markings and patterns.<ref name="ARCTroopers">{{TCW|ARC Troopers (episode)}}</ref>

Initially, Republic leadership was reluctant to allow the proliferation of ''kamas'' through the ranks. As ''kamas'' were thought of primarily as the garb of Mandalorians,<ref name="GttGAR" /> a people that had clashed with the Republic and the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who now led the Grand Army numerous times throughout history,<ref name="TEGW" /> their use by the clone soldiers was seen as potentially controversial. However, opinions were swayed into support<ref name="GttGAR" /> of the traditional half-kilt<ref name="Revelation" /> after it was pointed out that the indigenous Republic fighters of [[Rotas system/Legends|Rotas]] V had also worn ''kamas'' into battle.<ref name="GttGAR" /> Many in the Republic referred to the clone officers' ''kamas'' only by the generalized term "[[Commander/Legends|command]] skirts," and emphasized the connection to the Rotas V fighters<ref name="RotSVD" /> over the ''kama''{{'s}} ties to the Mandalorian culture.<ref name="GttGAR" /> In time, ''kamas'' became standard accessories on the specialized armor worn by [[Clone cold assault trooper/Legends|cold assault troopers]],<ref name="Trespass">{{TCW|Trespass}}</ref> [[Flame trooper/Legends|flame troopers]],<ref name="LaPR">{{TCW|Landing at Point Rain}}</ref> and the soldiers of the [[Galactic Marines/Legends|Galactic Marines]]. Though several standard army troopers<ref name="GttGAR" /> and [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commandos]] teasingly derided ''kamas'' as mere skirts, more fashion than function,<ref name="TZ" /> ''kama''-wearing clone troops found this criticism spurious in light of the protection the leather armor afforded them against crippling injury from low-flying shrapnel and debris on chaotic battlefields; many [[Clone jet trooper/Legends|jet troopers]] in particular found ''kamas'' to be good protection against jetpack down-wash.<ref name="GttGAR" />

[[File:327thStarCorps-ROTS.png|thumb|right|300px|[[Clone Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Bly/Legends|Bly]] and a cadre of ''kama''-wearing clone [[Officer/Legends|officers]] from the [[327th Star Corps/Legends|327th Star Corps]].]]
Though he had been one of the many clone soldiers to jokingly mock the ''kama'', clone commando [[Fi Skirata|Fi]] eagerly took possession of the discarded ''kama'' left behind by the ARC trooper [[Sull]] after he deserted from the Grand Army on [[Gaftikar]]. Fi subsequently scraped the blue edging off of the [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant's]] ''kama'' and kept the grey, kilt-like garment in his pack. After he suffered severe [[Brain/Legends|brain]] trauma during the Republic's later [[Battle of Gaftikar|assault]] on Gaftikar that left him in a comatose state, Fi was cared for by the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Bardan Jusik]], who used the sight of his recently acquired ''kama'' as a motivational tool to aid in the wounded soldier's [[Force healing/Legends|recovery]].<ref name="TC" /> As he made his slow recuperation on the Mandalorian [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]]—[[Smuggler/Legends|smuggled]] away from the [[Galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and the Republic medical system that had refused him long-term care because he was a clone soldier, and delivered into the care of [[Clan Skirata|the clan]] of his [[Gai bal manda|adopted]] father, [[Kal Skirata]]—Fi took to wearing his ''kama'' as part of the suit of Mandalorian armor he had acquired from the body of [[Ghez Hokan]] at the conclusion of [[Omega Squad]]'s first [[Mission to Qiilura|mission]]. As Fi's adopted brother, the ''Null''-class ARC trooper [[Ordo Skirata|Ordo]], was deserting the Grand Army in the aftermath of the Confederacy's [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|attack]] on Coruscant, he elected to keep the ''kama'' from his ARC trooper armor. Though he left the other pieces of [[Plastoid/Legends|plastoid]] behind, Ordo wrapped his clone trooper helmet in his ''kama'' and walked out of the then-empty [[Special Operations Brigade Headquarters]] in his own set of Mandalorian armor.<ref name="O66" />

By the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], numerous shops and merchant stalls situated along the length of [[Chortav Meshurkaane]]<ref name="ImpCom501st" />—"Gem-Cutters Street"<ref name="Mando'a">{{WebCite|url=http://www.karentraviss.com/page20/page26/index.html|text=Mando'a|author=Karen Traviss|work=[http://www.karentraviss.com Karen Traviss]|archivedate=20110925083955}}</ref>—in [[Keldabe/Legends|Keldabe]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of Mandalore, sold a number of leather goods including ''kamas'' on the city's twice-[[Standard week/Legends|weekly]] market [[Galactic Standard Calendar|days]].<ref name="ImpCom501st" /> That same year the Clone Wars came to an end, and the Republic was [[Declaration of a New Order|reorganized]] into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] under the authority of the former [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]], now the newly crowned [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]].<ref name="Declaration">{{InsiderCite|84|Republic HoloNet News Special Inaugural Edition 16:5:241}}</ref> Under the Empire, the [[Phase II clone trooper armor/Legends|armor]] worn by the clone troopers of the now [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] was ordered to be returned to its original white, with unit colors and markings scrubbed away, while accoutrements such as ''kamas'' were removed. However, after transitioning to [[Stormtrooper armor/Legends|stormtrooper armor]], some elite and specialized units were allowed unit markings and old accessories like pauldrons;<ref name="TEGW" /> ''kamas'' made a notable return as a part of Imperial [[Snowtrooper armor/Legends|snowtrooper armor]].<ref name="TESB">{{Film|V}}</ref>

[[File:Mandalorian_wedding.jpg|thumb|left|225px|[[Mirta Gev]], wearing her ''kama'' on the day of her [[Marriage/Legends|wedding]] to [[Ghes Orade]].]]
In [[41 ABY]], after tentatively reconciling with her previously estranged grandfather, the now reigning ''Mand'alor'' [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], the young [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Mirta Gev]] chose to follow her heritage and immerse herself in Mandalorian culture.<ref name="Sacrifice">''[[Legacy of the Force: Sacrifice]]''</ref> As she did, Gev upgraded the simple set of grey armor plates that she had used as a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] hunter<ref name="Bloodlines">''[[Legacy of the Force: Bloodlines]]''</ref> to a full set of traditional Mandalorian armor, with saffron-colored plates forged of [[Beskar/Legends|''beskar'']] [[Iron/Legends|iron]].<ref name="Revelation" /> Gev also acquired a yellow-colored ''kama'' to match her armor plates, and wore the ''kama'' on the day of her [[Wedding of Ghes Orade and Mirta Gev|wedding]]<ref name="TMPaC">{{InsiderCite|86|The Mandalorians: People and Culture}}</ref> in [[41 ABY]] to the Mandalorian soldier [[Ghes Orade]]. [[Goran Beviin]], another Mandalorian and mutual friend to both Gev and her grandfather Boba Fett, donned a dark blue ''kama'' in coordination with his cobalt-blue armor when he attended the celebratory festivities alongside his husband, [[Medrit Vasur]], at the [[Novoc Vevut's home|Keldabe home]] shared by Gev and Orade.<ref name="Revelation" />

Nearly a [[Standard century/Legends|century]] later, in [[127 ABY]], numerous Mandalorian soldiers fighting under ''Mand'alor'' [[Chernan Ordo]] against the forces of the [[Fel Empire]] at the [[Battle of Botajef]] wore ''kamas'' attached to their armor. Ten years after the battle, the Mandalorian couple [[Tes Vevec]] and [[Hondo Karr]] both adorned their armor with ''kamas''; Vevec wore a maroon-colored ''kama'', while Karr's was black, matching the color of his armor.<ref name="Rogue'sEnd">[[Legacy (2006) 41|''Legacy'' (2006) 41]]</ref>
